candidates.text:
Toured a $60M ag bank in western Kansas today. 0.5x tangible book. One branch, one drive-thru, one bathroom.

The bathroom is the problem.

Took a dump during due diligence and the toilet backed up into the vault. Board called it "a liquidity event."

CEO didn't flinch. Said this happens every harvest. They've been booking it as "other real estate owned" since 1987.

Made an offer on the spot. Asked for a 20% haircut for the plumbing. They countered with a seat on the board and a plunger.

I accepted.

The deposit base, like the vault floor, is now sticky, uninsured, and deeply embedded in the community.
